electricalAngleOfInverter2Against: Electrical angle of inverter 2 against inverter 1 (dual 3-phase is usually 30°). It changes the DC-link ripple, not the device losses.
rmsCurrentOfOnePhaseOne: RMS current of ONE phase (one inverter leg), continuous.
fundamentalElectricalFrequencyTheCarrier: Fundamental electrical frequency. The carrier is rounded to a whole number of periods of it (synchronous modulation).
displacementPowerFactorOfTheLoad: Displacement power factor of the load. Sets the power (and the efficiency), not the device losses.
thePowerDeviceFromTheCatalogue: The power device, from the catalogue below. Its card carries the datasheet numbers this solve uses.
dual3PhaseTheXY: Dual 3-phase: the x-y plane links no air-gap flux, only leakage limits its current. Required for two inverters — no field solve here measures it.
carrierPhaseShiftOfInverter2: Carrier phase shift of inverter 2 against inverter 1, 0–180° of a carrier period. Trades alpha-beta ripple against x-y ripple.
optionalPhaseCurrentThdPwmRipple: Optional: phase-current THD (PWM ripple / fundamental) above this is flagged FAIL.
howTheBridgesAreCombinedWith: How the bridges are combined with the motor: one inverter, two inverters on alternate coils, an H-bridge per coil, or an explicit coil-to-bridge mapping.
unipolarSwitchesTheTwoLegsAgainst: Unipolar switches the two legs against opposite references — the coil sees twice the ripple frequency and half the step. Bipolar switches the diagonals together.
gateOffVoltage0VOr: Gate-off voltage: 0 V or −5 V. It changes both the turn-off energy and the body-diode drop during dead time.
bothSwitchesOfALegOff: Both switches of a leg off. The current then runs through a SiC body diode at ~4 V, so this is expensive — and it is what distorts the output voltage at every current zero crossing.
liquidColdplateForcedAirFanSlipstream: Liquid coldplate, forced air (fan/slipstream) or still air (no fan) — the same three the thermal simulation offers for the housing, now for the device heatsink/plate.
howManyPlatesUsuallyOnePer: How many plates (usually one per module) the flow is split over or runs through. At least 2.
aHeatsinkBoltedToEachDevice: A heatsink bolted to EACH device, or one PCB pad shared by every device on it.
everyPublishedLimitOfTheChosen: Every published limit of the chosen device with the number this duty reaches. A line that is not judged is one the datasheet does not publish or this model does not compute — never a pass by omission.
whatTheCoilActuallySeesThe: What the coil actually sees: the PWM terminal voltage with the device drops and the dead-time windows, over the phase current. The voltage error the dead time causes flips sign at every current zero crossing.
everyBlockNeedsASourceLine: Every block needs a source line naming the table or figure it was transcribed from. A value the datasheet does not publish stays out — the loss model says so rather than guessing.

configureDrive.invLossTip: Controller loss: conduction + switching + dead time of every device in the bridge, plus the copper of the coil links on the controller board. 0 W in a sine drive.

configureDrive.frequencyTip: Only the PWM frequencies computed for this transistor in this motor. Changing the transistor keeps the frequency when it exists, else the nearest computed one.
configureDrive.motorEffTip: Motor efficiency: shaft power over the motor's input power (motor losses incl. the PWM extra loss), for reference. The Efficiency tile is the whole system, motor + controller.

configureLimits.connSeries: all series — highest voltage, lowest current
configureLimits.connParallel: all parallel — lowest voltage, highest current

configureLimits.badTurns: {n} wires is not a whole number of {k}-in-hand turns
configureLimits.badTurnsTip: This build is wound {k} wires in hand, so the slot's wire count must be a multiple of {k}: {n} wires would make {turns} turns per coil, which is not a winding. Use {lo} or {hi}.
configureLimits.atLimitTip: {n} rows × ({wire} mm wire + {gap} mm gap) = {stack} mm of {avail} mm usable slot height — the sliders stop here so the winding stays inside the stator.
configureLimits.stockTip: Compared against the flat wire physically on the shelf (Materials tab → Flat wire in stock). Not enforced yet.
configureLimits.lHand: max {max} mm · set for this motor
configureLimits.lHandTip: The stack-length maximum was set by hand for this motor (admin). Admins edit it here; it applies to every user.
configureLimits.lDefaultTip: No maximum is set for this motor, so the default rule applies (a multiple of the reference length). An admin can set one by editing the maximum.
configureLimits.clearHandTip: Remove the hand-set maximum and fall back to the default rule.
configureLimits.nFitTip: The most wire rows that fit the slot at {wire} mm wire ({avail} mm usable height). The maximum follows the wire thickness live.
configureLimits.wireFitTip: Minimum 0.2 mm (manufacturing limit), step 0.1 mm. The maximum is the thickest wire at which the chosen turns still fit the slot.
configureLimits.iInverterTip: The machine's own inverter: one switch carries its leg's current for half the period, so its rms is the leg current / √2. The limit is where that equals the device's continuous rating ({rating} A at {tcase} °C case, junction at its limit) × devices in parallel — the same rule the Controller tab judges by. Applies in Sine mode too.
configureLimits.iNoControllerTip: No inverter device is saved with this machine, so the passport rule applies for the current maximum. A selected PWM transistor below is a precomputed drive reference; it does not set this machine's saved current limit.
configureLimits.rpmEnvelopeTip: Highest speed at which the passport's voltage model, at the current set here, stays within the fully charged pack ({v} V) × modulation index {m}.
configureLimits.rpmKvTip: Kv × fully charged pack voltage ({v} V) × modulation index {m} (the passport has no voltage model).
configureLimits.rpmNoBatteryTip: No battery is set and no pack voltage is known for this machine, so the default rule applies for the speed maximum.
configureLimits.resetToReferenceTip: Put every knob back to the reference design (the motor as loaded)

configure.subtitle: {slots}-slot / {poles}-pole · ~{torque} N·m @ {rpm} rpm

configure.ktTip2d: 2-D: no 3-D result exists for this machine.
configure.totalLossTip: Sum of all losses: the motor losses, the PWM extra loss and the controller loss incl. its board copper (the last two are 0 W in a sine drive). Efficiency = Power / (Power + Total loss).
configure.totalLossBlankTip: Withheld: the PWM point is refused or lacks a loss, so the total is unknown.
configure.statorHeatTipMeasured: Stator iron + all copper. The scaled iron loss is split by the ratio the passport measured at its base point.
configure.statorHeatTipUnknown: Stator iron + all copper. The scaled iron loss is split by the ratio the passport measured at its base point — iron split unknown here, so the WHOLE iron loss is on the stator (regenerate the passport).
configure.rotorHeatTipMeasured: Rotor iron + magnet/solid loss — it can only leave across the air gap or through the shaft. Stator + rotor = the Total loss tile.
configure.rotorHeatTipUnknown: Rotor iron + magnet/solid loss — it can only leave across the air gap or through the shaft. Stator + rotor = the Total loss tile; the rotor IRON share is unknown here and sits on the stator side (regenerate the passport).
configure.leadCableTip: Catalogue silicone lead ({strands}): {area} mm² copper — the first size at or above the phase section {section} mm². Conductor Ø{d} mm, insulation O.D. Ø{od}±0.1 mm (wall {thk} mm), {r} Ω/km, {irated} A continuous / {imax} A peak, {roll} m per roll.

configure.cableSuspect75: sheet conductor O.D. reads 1.5 mm for a 75 mm² cable — impossible; 11.5 mm assumed (its neighbours are 10.9 and 12.7)
configure.rPhaseTip: Phase resistance at the coil temperature, end-winding included — the R the copper loss is billed from.
configure.rLineLineTip: 2 × R phase — what an ohmmeter across two leads of the isolated-neutral star reads.
configure.lqLdTip: Saliency ratio of the two dq inductances.
configure.coldConstantsUnavailable: 20°C constant not calculated for this reference.
configure.referenceTemperatureBasis: Reference solve: {length} mm, {rpm} rpm, {current} A; winding {winding}°C, magnet {magnet}°C, steel {steel}. 2D analytical scaling; no new FEM solve.
configure.stackCoefficientsTip: The reference saturation and demagnetisation calculation is available only at the reference stack length.
configure.stackCoefficientsOnlyAt: Reference coefficients shown only at {mm} mm
configure.stackCoefficientsOnlyAudited: Reference coefficients shown only at the audited stack length
configure.demagKoefTip: Demag coefficient: torque kept after irreversible demagnetisation, against fresh magnets.
configure.saturationKoefTip: Saturation coefficient: torque kept with real saturating iron, against linear iron.

The bus is the exact root of V_bus = V_oc + I·R_pack with I = P_charge/V_bus (R_pack = {cells}·{rint} mΩ / {np} = {rpack} mΩ).
configure.maxChipTip: The most charge power any current between {lo} and {hi} A reaches at {rpm} rpm, with every pack and modulation limit held. {tail}{click}
configure.maxChipTop: It sits at the TOP of that range: nothing in the pack or the modulation stopped it — the machine's own current ceiling (conductor headroom and the measured demagnetisation knee) did.
configure.maxChipRanOut: the sweep ran out of measured current
configure.maxChipClick: Click to set the current knob there.
configure.chargePowerTip: Mechanical power in, minus every loss the card reports. Ideal bridge — a real charger delivers less.
configure.chargeCurrentTip: P_charge / V_bus — the balance number, because that is the honest power.
configure.cRateTip: from the pack on the configuration
configure.busUnderChargeTip: Charging pushes current through R_pack the other way from a discharge, so the terminal sits ABOVE the open circuit. V_oc {voc} V{packMax}.
configure.etaChargeTip: Shaft in → pack in. The pack's own I²R is reported separately and is NOT in the machine's efficiency.
configure.limWhyNone: nothing is capping this point — the shaft power is the limit
configure.limWhyPack: the pack would be pushed above its maximum terminal voltage
configure.limWhyModulation: the bus cannot synthesise the voltage this point needs
configure.chargeMapTitle: Charge map — P_charge at the max-charge current
configure.chargeMapTip: At every speed the current knob is swept over the passport's own measured range and the best feasible point kept. The band under the curve is what stops it going higher at that speed.

Cooling air {air} m/s.

emTiles.torqueTip: Mean electromagnetic torque of THIS run, averaged over one electrical period.
emTiles.powerTip: Shaft power, at the coupling: rotor power T·ω ({rotor} kW) {op} {mech} W of bearings and windage, which sit between the rotor and the coupling. The efficiency is computed from it.
emTiles.massTip: Total mass: stator and rotor iron, copper, magnets, sleeve, shaft. Housing and bearings are not in it. EM-active part alone: {active} kg.
emTiles.efficiencyTip: Efficiency at the shaft: shaft power out over electrical power in (reversed for a generator), what a dynamometer reads. All losses are in it, bearings and windage included. Electromagnetic only it would read {em} %.
emTiles.tRippleTip: Torque ripple of this run: (T max − T min) / |T avg| over the solved window.
emTiles.pPerMassTip: Rotor power over the total mass.
emTiles.totalLossTip: All losses of the assembled machine: electromagnetic {em} W + bearings and windage {mech} W. Efficiency = Power / (Power + Total loss) for a motor.
emTiles.ironLossTip: Iron loss of the stator and rotor steel of this run, from the assigned steel's own loss model.
emTiles.copperLossTip: Copper loss of this run: I²R at the solve temperature plus the solved AC share, end-winding included.
emTiles.magnetLossTip: Eddy-current loss in the magnets of this run, period mean.
emTiles.statorHeatTip: Heat the stator has to shed: stator iron + all copper — what the cooling is sized on.
emTiles.rotorHeatTip: Heat the rotor has to shed: rotor iron + magnet, shaft and sleeve eddy. Stator + rotor = the electromagnetic part of Total loss, exactly.
emTiles.splitUnknown: This run carries no per-half iron breakdown, so the whole core loss is billed to the stator side.
emTiles.lossDensityTip: Electromagnetic loss over the mass, the thermal-stress indicator (the bearings are not in the active mass).
emTiles.ctrlLossTip: Controller loss of this run: conduction + switching + dead time of every device in the bridge, plus the copper of the coil links on its board.
emTiles.tjTip: Hottest device junction of this run.
emTiles.motorEffTip: Motor efficiency of this run, from its controller block: shaft power over the motor's own input power, for reference.
emTiles.pContTip: Largest continuous shaft power this machine holds for ever at this run's speed and cooling.
emTiles.unverified: This run's continuous-rating search did not verify this number — treat it as an estimate.
emTiles.dcBusMinTip: The smallest DC bus this run needs: its peak line voltage — what the battery must cover.
emTiles.vLinePeakTip: Peak line-to-line voltage of this run's waveforms.
emTiles.vPhasePeakTip: Peak phase voltage of this run's waveform.
emTiles.vLineRmsTip: True RMS of this run's line-to-line waveforms.
emTiles.vPhaseRmsTip: True RMS of this run's phase waveform.
emTiles.currDensityTip: Coil current density of this run: I phase RMS over the phase copper section.
emTiles.phaseSectionTip: Copper section the phase current flows through — I phase over it is exactly the current density above.
emTiles.fillFactorTip: Measured copper over the winding window of this machine's model.
emTiles.rAtSolve: At the coil temperature this run was solved at: {t} °C.
emTiles.rAt25: At 25 °C (the bench-check view; this run was solved at {t} °C).
emTiles.psiTip: Magnet flux linkage of THIS run (phase, peak), measured at zero current.
emTiles.kvTip: No-load KV of THIS run: rpm per volt of the fundamental back-EMF — what spinning it on the bench reads.
emTiles.kvTipLoaded: Loaded KV of THIS run: rpm per volt of its terminal voltage. This run carries no no-load KV.
emTiles.ktTip: Torque constant of THIS run at this operating point: T / I phase RMS. Measured here, so load saturation is inside it.
emTiles.kmTip: Motor constant of THIS run: torque per square root of the DC copper loss paid for it.
emTiles.kmPerMassTip: Specific motor constant of this run: Km over the total mass.
emTiles.fromRun: Measured on THIS run's own field (irreversible demagnetisation and saturating iron), never taken from another run.
emTiles.mSecant: Frozen-permeability secant — this run predates the differential measurement.
emTiles.mBench: Bench small-signal probe at zero current.
emTiles.mHybrid: Torque method: energy mean with Maxwell ripple.
emTiles.powerTipRotor: Rotor power T·ω of this run. This machine has no bearings, so the shaft's own friction is unknown, not zero: assign them in Mechanical → Shaft & bearings and this becomes the power at the coupling.
emTiles.elecPowerTipMotor: Electrical power at the terminals (input): shaft power plus all losses.
emTiles.elecPowerTipGen: Electrical power at the terminals (output): shaft power minus all losses.
emTiles.elecPowerNoMech: Without bearings only the electromagnetic loss is in it.
emTiles.efficiencyTipNoMech: * Electromagnetic efficiency only: this machine has no bearings, so the friction is unknown, not zero. The shaft efficiency is lower by an amount nobody can see until they are assigned (Mechanical → Shaft & bearings).
emTiles.partial: * PARTIAL: magnet and shaft eddy losses were not solved on this run, so this efficiency is optimistic and must not be compared with a current-drive run.
emTiles.totalLossTipEm: Electromagnetic losses only: iron + copper + magnet and shaft eddy, period means. This machine has no bearings, so bearings and windage are unknown, not zero.
emTiles.shaftLossTip: Eddy-current loss in the shaft over the cycle (period mean): the solid conductor inside the rotor yoke. Part of the rotor heat.
emTiles.sleeveLossTip: Eddy loss in the carbon-fibre retaining ring. Milliwatts on purpose: a hoop-wound sleeve conducts very little across its fibres.
emTiles.noBearings: No bearings on this machine, so this loss is unknown, not zero. Assign them in Mechanical → Shaft & bearings and it fills in.
emTiles.bearingsTip: Bearing friction, {cards}, by the SKF frictional-moment model at {temp} °C (analytic, not the field solve). Part of Total loss.
emTiles.windageTip: Air drag on the rotor: gap friction {gap} W + the two end faces {faces} W (analytic, not the field solve). Part of Total loss.
emTiles.eddyUnsettled: The eddy warm-up ended before the start-up transient settled, so this number is over-read.
emTiles.notSolved: Not solved on this run: rotor eddy was off, so magnet and shaft eddy losses are missing and the efficiency is optimistic.
emTiles.magnetSeg: The magnets are sliced axially ({slice} mm slices of a {stack} mm stack, loop width {width} mm): the 2-D eddy loss is multiplied by {factor}. A model, and a lower bracket.
emTiles.ironBertotti: Bertotti loss in stator and rotor steel, fitted to the material's measured curves; alternating-axis basis, manufacturing degradation not included.
emTiles.ironMeasured: From the manufacturer's measured P(B, f) table, interpolated directly; alternating-axis basis, manufacturing degradation not included.
emTiles.wallToShaftTip: Inverter efficiency × shaft efficiency: the power stage on top of the machine's own shaft efficiency. A different quantity from the Efficiency tile.
emTiles.iWindingTip: Delta: the current in ONE winding = the line current ÷ √3. It is what the field was driven with and what the current density is billed on.
emTiles.turnsCoilTip: Series turns per coil. Wound {hand} wires in hand with {strips} strips in series per row; the phase current splits over {paths} conductors.
emTiles.bGapMeanTip: Mean |B| over the air-gap clearance, averaged over the electrical period: the whole gap under load, magnet flux and armature reaction together.
emTiles.lxyTip: Six-phase: the inductance between the two sets driven against each other (circulating x-y current). It alone limits PWM current flowing from one inverter into the other.
emTiles.perSetTip: Six-phase: each of the two in-phase sets carries half the phase current at the full phase voltage (fundamental peak).
emTiles.rotorInertiaTip: Rotor moment of inertia about the shaft axis, from the same CAD sections as the mass. Drive sizing: t_accel = J·Δω/T.
emTiles.brCornerTip: Worst single magnet element: a corner flag, not the magnet's figure (that is Demag coef.). A sharp-corner value that does not converge with mesh refinement.
emTiles.end3dTip: Axial end-effect correction ×{k} from the 3D static solve of THIS machine: multiply the 2D flux, EMF and torque by it.
emTiles.end3dInherited: Inherited from an earlier geometry of this machine: recompute Stage A.
emTiles.demagArea: {area} % of the magnet area is de-rated.
emTiles.partTip: Mass of this part and its share of the total mass.
emTiles.partRefTip: Customer-supplied part: it is in the field and in the losses but not billed in the mass; shown at the mass it was modelled at.
emTiles.ironSplitStator: Stator iron {st} W: hysteresis {sh} / eddy {se} / excess {sx} W.
emTiles.ironSplitRotor: Rotor iron {rt} W: hysteresis {rh} / eddy {re} / excess {rx} W.

configureApplication.label: Application
configureApplication.tip: What this machine is used for. It decides whether the propeller controls are offered.
